title: Grocery Shopping for the Week
paragraphs: Every Saturday morning, Halim goes to the market to buy groceries for the whole week, a routine he started after realizing daily shopping wasted too much of his limited free time.
He always brings a list written the night before, based on simple meal plans he and his wife discussed together, so he does not end up buying things they do not actually need.
At the market, he checks the freshness of vegetables carefully, something his mother taught him years ago, gently pressing tomatoes and smelling the fish before deciding to buy.
This weekly habit takes about an hour, but it saves him considerable time and money during the busy weekdays, since the kitchen is already fully stocked before Monday arrives.
Halim admits the habit felt tedious at first, but now he actually enjoys the quiet market mornings, chatting briefly with familiar sellers he has come to know over the years.
